display.name: Dawnreef Atoll
display.summary: A bright starter reef where lantern-stone keeps the sky-island stable.
display.description: Dawnreef Atoll is a compact mobile-friendly starter zone with warm shallows, reed bridges, and a dimming Lantern Well.

sunthread_reeds.title: A note held in sunthread
sunthread_reeds.text: You let the reeds settle. Three low notes remain after the wind fades; the last seems to pull toward the sealed cistern. Nothing here needs to be harvested.

saltglass_cistern.title: An answer beneath the gate
saltglass_cistern.text: Beyond the sealed stone, the same three notes return in reverse. A narrow line of light wakes in an old hinge, then fades. You leave the gate closed. Mara should hear about this.
